description: Source code for password management and SRP authentication, including functions for opening, reading, and handling password entries, as well as system password initialization and setup.

methods.name: t_serveropen
methods.description: Opens a server connection for a given username.

methods.name: t_openpw
methods.description: Opens a password file stream, deprecated when called with NULL.

methods.name: t_openpwbyname
methods.description: Opens a password file by filename.

methods.name: t_closepw
methods.description: Closes a password file stream and frees resources.

methods.name: gettpnam
methods.description: Retrieves password and configuration info for a given username.
